title: Virginia Avenue over I-65 NB / I-70 EB | proposed 2026 rehabilitation
source_note: INDOT B-44576 primary 2026 design. Retained original framing and 2013 northbound girder replacement are sourced only from identified pages of document 9548460. Separate southbound/I-70, cathodic-protection and lighting pages are not dimensional authority. Original files remain unchanged.
status_note: Whole crossing present; amber because field elevations, wingwall shape, connections, rail/approach transitions and small fittings remain approximate. Proposed 2026 work is not proof of completion.
assumptions: Whole-crossing exterior reconstruction of the stated proposed design, not an as-built survey or confirmation of construction completion.
Amber / needs_detail: fabrication tolerances, exact field seats, local notches and transitions, small fittings, and terrain remain incomplete.
Internal reinforcement, shear studs, embedded anchors and welds are omitted. No rendered component is a finite element or a solid-stress result.
Any later FEM must freeze its own material, stiffness, connectivity and support assumptions. Visual mesh volume is not a section-property source.
Foundations are hidden by default; foundation envelopes are design references and do not establish actual field embedment.
Linear grade through the primary bearing profile elevations replaces the 90/96 ft vertical curves; deck height is a local visualization datum.
Historical 54/60 in labels are WEB depths; total I-section depths include both flanges. Plate schedules are source-backed, but fillets and taper details are simplified.
Source revisions 9715471 and 9715512 concern special provisions and inspection coordination; no replacement geometry sheets were identified.

detail_coverage.detail: Nine girders, 2026 deck, broad south path, narrow north sidewalk, all bays, both wall abutments and approach slabs.

Piecewise 2013 girder 1 and original girders 2-9; splice covers, V/X frames and 18 bearing envelopes. Historical original PDF references are stored per component. 2013 Girder 1-2 end cross-frames on both bearing lines (existing sheets 10, 14).
TX windowed rail, south ornamental top rail, paver envelope, six light bollards and source drain collector.
Exact field seats and camber, bolts/gussets, splayed wings and local abutment batter, transition rail terminals, paver pattern, exact rail molds, buried utilities and surrounding interstate.
